Title: Ayaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ayaan - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Hema - 34 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Kavya - 12 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
4. Vimla - 63 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ayaan stands in the living room. Hema and Kavya stand near him.]

Kavya: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ayaan reads a storybook.]

Ayaan (surprised): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Ayaan studies for his exam.]

Ayaan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Ayaan does his homework at the table.]

Ayaan: "How beautiful!"

[Ayaan types on his laptop.]

Kavya: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
